hooks.prompt: A new session has started. This project uses a wiki at ./wiki/ as its living context layer. Read wiki/_snapshot.md first (one page, ~30-second bootstrap). Then read wiki/_active/now.md for current task and the last 10 entries of wiki/log.md. If you are unfamiliar with the wiki conventions, also read wiki/HOWTO.md. Drill into other pages only as needed — use wiki/index.md as your map.
